_readme: Ledger of recorded pre-build competitor+keyword gap checks for (Core-parent-pattern, locale) cells and gated-tail-pattern build exceptions — the instrument that replaces incidental discovery (the FR /symbol/ blind spot: EN had 77 symbol pages, FR had 6, and nothing flagged the ~49,960/mo of French demand until a manual Semrush pull found it) with a standing, recorded pass. Read/written by scripts/audit-locale-parent-gap.js (whole-site discovery) and scripts/check-locale-parent-gap.js (per-PR gate). Do NOT add or edit an entry here unilaterally — every entry must reflect a real, run instrument check, discussed with the user the same way data/translation_parity_exceptions.json entries are (see CLAUDE.md, 'Locale Parent Governance'). Entry shape: { pattern (a data/core_parent_set.json pattern string, e.g. "symbol/*"), locale (locale code), checkedDate (YYYY-MM-DD), instruments: { competitorFootprintInLocale: bool|null, keywordVolumeInLocaleMonthly: number|null, enGscImpressionsFromLocale: number|null } — null means that instrument was not run/available, not zero, evidence (short citation of where the numbers came from), recordedBy }. verdict: "mirror" (Core parent, demand confirms the default — informational, not required for the check to pass), "veto" (Core parent, pre-build check showed genuinely negligible demand — overrides the default-mirror), "gate-pass" (gated-tail parent, pre-build check cleared threshold — authorizes the build), "gate-fail" (gated-tail parent, pre-build check did not clear threshold — build not authorized). scripts/check-locale-parent-gap.js treats "mirror" and "gate-pass" as passing verdicts for a newly-shipped locale page; "veto" and "gate-fail" record that a page was deliberately NOT built. Do not invent additional entries with fabricated numbers — every cell without a real entry here is genuinely unaudited right now, which is exactly the gap this tooling exists to surface, not paper over.

Real competitor-footprint evidence found via web search in place of Semrush: fi.piliapp.com (a dedicated Finnish subdomain of an existing multi-locale competitor already tracked elsewhere in this repo's research), cooltextmaker.com/fi/, urwatools.com/fi/, and adamfaliq.com/fi/bold-text-generator-suomi/ all independently serve Finnish-language "fonttigeneraattori"/"tekstigeneraattori" (font/text generator) content today. The private ultratextgen-lab- repo's research/language-expansion-opportunities.md separately scored Finnish as a Phase-1 candidate (5.5M speakers, very high purchasing power, low competition, excellent Latin-script compatibility) alongside ms/da/hu, all three already live. Every prior minimal-locale launch (hr, hu, da, ms) shipped an equivalent homepage + top-level Discord/Instagram platform pages the same way.

zh-tw is Tier 3 hold-stub in data/locale_qualification_tiers.json, so the Tier-3 skip fires ahead of library/*'s own Core tier regardless — this entry is a user-authorized override of that hold for a specific, scoped slice of library/*, not a change to zh-tw's tier or hold flag. User was told directly that zh-tw is Tier 3/hold-stub and that its one proven first-party win is narrowly the game-name vertical (per the existing zh-tw entry in this ledger and data/locale_qualification_tiers.json's zh-tw notes) before authorizing this build. Competitor-footprint instrument (piliapp.com organic positions export, db=tw, pulled 2026-07-31) cleared for three specific library/* collection pages: tw.piliapp.com/symbol/arrow/ (~27,908/mo modeled traffic, 115 ranking keywords), tw.piliapp.com/symbol/number/ (~20,376/mo, 214 keywords), tw.piliapp.com/symbol/star/ (~16,577/mo, 88 keywords) — mapping to EN parents library/arrow-symbols/, library/number-symbols/, library/star-symbols/. No direct TW keyword-volume pull was run against the arrow/number/star terms specifically (the broad-match exports supplied this session were seeded on "emoji", "字體"/font, "fb", and "表情符號", not "箭頭"/"數字"/"星星"), so keywordVolumeInLocaleMonthly is left null rather than estimated — the competitor-footprint instrument alone is what's clearing the gated-tail threshold here. Scope is limited to these three library/* collection slugs; this is not a blanket library/* mirror decision for zh-tw (the existing zh-tw entry's "deepen the game-name vertical, not blanket Core mirroring" guidance still stands for the rest of library/* and all of symbol/*).

Covers zh-tw/ig-ziti/, the translation of the EN instagram/ platform page (a bare top-level page with no data/core_parent_set.json pattern, so classifyParent() reports pattern: null / tier "unclassified"; the Tier-3-locale check still fires, hence this entry). User-authorized override of zh-tw's Tier 3 hold-stub default, presented before the decision, per the vi-override template — zh-tw's tier and hold flag left untouched. Keyword instrument: Semrush db=tw broad-match export (pulled 2026-07-31, seed "字體"), IG/Instagram cluster = 105,480/mo normalized, led by "ig 字體" 74,000/mo KD 31 — larger than "英文字體" 27,100/mo, the term the existing zh-tw/yingwen-ziti/ page targets. Competitor instrument: tw.piliapp.com/instagram/fonts/ = ~173,913/mo modeled traffic across 360 ranking keywords, its 2nd-highest-traffic page site-wide, top keyword "ig 字體". zh-tw had no Instagram page of any kind before this build. Also records the Rule 3 de-confliction applied in the same change: zh-tw/yingwen-ziti/ had an IG-targeting FAQ answer, now reduced to a pointer link at the new page.

Covers zh-tw/shufa-ziti/ (translation of category/cursive-fonts/) and zh-tw/keai-ziti/ (translation of category/cute-fonts/). TWO overrides recorded together, both user-authorized after being presented: (1) zh-tw is Tier 3 hold-stub, same override shape as the entries above; (2) category/* is scriptIndependent:false — the registry's standing guidance is that Latin-transform category pages do NOT mirror into CJK locales, and that a script-appropriate Core subset be substituted instead. That second default is overridden here on direct evidence that the TW demand IS for Latin-script transforms, not Chinese-script ones: the top TW keyword on tw.piliapp.com/cool-text/cursive/ is "英文草寫" — literally "English cursive" — and that page draws ~19,390/mo modeled traffic across 162 keywords. The same reasoning already underpins the ratified zh-tw/yingwen-ziti/ local-only page (a CJK-script-user tool for decorating Latin text). Both new pages state the Latin-only scope explicitly in their own copy rather than implying Chinese glyphs transform. Keyword instrument (Semrush db=tw broad-match, 2026-07-31): cursive cluster 書法 19,350/mo + 手寫 17,500/mo (head terms 書法字體 8,100 KD 23, 手寫字體 6,600 KD 32); cute cluster 9,720/mo (head term 可愛字體 3,600 KD 24) — 46,570/mo combined. Competitor instrument for the cute page is weaker and recorded as such: piliapp has no dedicated cute-font page, ranking its IG page #1 for 可愛字體 instead.
